node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_a_descope_is_written_on_any_plan.py shows four things on a temporary copy of a plan with no section records and bare h2 headings, modelled on nova's at 72cb4fccc : The dotted form with a reason stores the descope, and a fresh read returns the declaration descoped and the reason. The whole-map form with a reasoned value for one section and plain strings for the rest does the same. An unreasoned descope is still refused, and the refusal text names a form that the first case shows succeeding. A plan that does carry section records keeps the reason on the record, as before. Two negative controls each make one case fail. Removing the map store fails the first case. Removing the whole-map normalisation fails the second. The test files importing reckon._store add no failure against the base revision. Ruff adds no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/_store.py , reckon/_plan_html.py and the new test.
